title: New law: Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Internal Revenue Service relating to "Gross Proceeds Reporting by Brokers That Regularly Provide Services Effectuating Digital Asset Sales". (Public Law 119-5)
summary: H.J.Res. 25 of the 119th Congress became Public Law 119-5 on 2025-04-10.
